answer: Proof of Personhood using verifiable biometrics creates a digital island of secure identity, preventing agents from scaling fake accounts. Each validated node acts like a knoll above the noisy landscape of automated bots. This crystal clear barrier imposes a significant financial cost on attackers, who must acquire unique, non-fungible biological entropy for every node, effectively rendering mass-scale Sybil attacks economically unviable in a high-stakes decentralized economy.
